/bin/bash -lc "mkdir -p /workspace/topology_output && /opt/conda/bin/pvpython - <<'PY'
from paraview.simple import *
from paraview import servermanager
LoadPlugin('/opt/conda/bin/plugins/TopologyToolKit/TopologyToolKit.so',remote=False,ns=globals())
r=XMLImageDataReader(FileName=['QMCPACK.vti'])
s=TTKTopologicalSimplificationByPersistence(Input=r)
s.InputArray=['POINTS','Scalars_']; s.PersistenceThreshold=0.04; s.ThresholdIsAbsolute=0
print('props',s.PersistenceThreshold,s.ThresholdIsAbsolute)
s.UpdatePipeline()
d=servermanager.Fetch(s)
print('simpl output',d.GetClassName(),d.GetPointData().GetNumberOfArrays(),[d.GetPointData().GetArrayName(i) for i in range(d.GetPointData().GetNumberOfArrays())],d.GetNumberOfPoints())
cp=TTKScalarFieldCriticalPoints(Input=s); cp.ScalarField=['POINTS','Scalars_'];cp.UpdatePipeline(); c=servermanager.Fetch(cp)
print('cp',c.GetClassName(),c.GetNumberOfBlocks() if hasattr(c,'GetNumberOfBlocks') else '',c.GetNumberOfPoints() if hasattr(c,'GetNumberOfPoints') else '')
for i in range(c.GetNumberOfBlocks()):
 b=c.GetBlock(i); print(i,b.GetClassName(), b.GetNumberOfPoints(), [b.GetPointData().GetArrayName(j) for j in range(b.GetPointData().GetNumberOfArrays())])
